verdict.rationale: Reducto documents a Split endpoint that returns the page ranges for sections you describe in natural language. It also has a Classify endpoint that labels a document against your categories with confidence scores. A single upload ID can be passed to Classify, Split, Parse and Extract, and multi-step workflows or Studio pipelines chain classification, parsing and extraction into one call. However, the docs frame Split as locating sections within a document and never show a packet being broken into its constituent documents, each auto-classified and extracted separately. Split also never appears among the chained workflow steps, and the user must predefine the sections, so 'automatic' packet handling has to be assembled from separate pieces. Missing for 10: explicit multi-document packet splitting with per-segment classification, a documented split→per-document extraction flow returned from one upload, independent or hands-on corroboration.
